synthetic_caveat: SYNTHETIC (LOWER BOUND): The foreign-consume stub (sink.on_frame) copies the RustBuffer into an owned Vec<u8> via destroy_into_vec(), modeling the floor cost of Swift Data / Kotlin ByteArray construction. Real ARC/GC bookkeeping is NOT modeled; the pre-registered 3× surcharge compensates.

SYNTHETIC (NOT EXECUTED): JNI boundary surcharge (GetByteArrayElements, SetByteArrayRegion, local-ref table) is NOT executed. It is applied only as the pre-registered conservative 3× multiplier band from published JNI numbers.

SYNTHETIC (NOT MODELED): Real cross-language thread/dispatch-queue handoff and on-device backpressure drop/reorder. In-process single listener thread; cross-language hop deferred and labeled as out-of-scope for this bench. Dropped/reordered frames = 0 by in-process construction; this is NOT a real-transport claim.

REAL (EXECUTED): C-lane indirect Arc<dyn Fn> call + ptr/len dispatch + mandatory one shell-copy (Vec::to_vec) per frame. UniFFI Rust-side cost: RustBuffer allocation, FfiConverter Lower::lower serialization (4-byte i32 prefix + per-byte write via uniffi_core 0.29.5), and indirect vtable dispatch through Box<dyn UpdateFrameSink>. Synthetic foreign-copy component (145 ns at weighted mean 3737 B, 40 ns/KB conservative estimate) multiplied by 3× surcharge in verdict.
notes: Workload: ADR-0055 omit-unchanged regime. SMALL 256–2048 B (80%), MEDIUM 2048–8192 B (15%), LARGE 16384–65536 B (5%). 100k deliveries per bucket per lane after 10k warmup discarded. Cadence grounded in code: steady 4 Hz (DEFAULT_EMIT_HZ), burst to 12 Hz (clamp ceiling).
Empty-harness baseline (timer+index, no transport) subtracted from every per-frame measurement. SMALL baseline ≈ 0 ns, MEDIUM ≈ 0 ns, LARGE ≈ 0 ns.
Platform: macOS (Darwin 25.5.0), single-threaded, no tokio. CPU affinity unpinned (macOS does not expose CPU pinning in userspace); compensated by high iteration count + percentiles.

Pre-registered decision rule (encoded before measurement): COLLAPSE iff surcharged weighted-p99 delta < 833333 ns (5% of 16.67ms) AND UniFFI SMALL p99 < 250000 ns; KEEP iff delta >= 2500000 ns (15%); ESCALATE otherwise. No COLLAPSE permitted from synthetic evidence inside or above the ESCALATE band.
